question: Does New Relic's Company Email field accept an address at a public mail domain such as gmail.com today?
why: The field is labelled Company Email. An October 2022 Medium walkthrough reports that a Gmail address was accepted, New Relic's documentation lists Google and Google Workplace as separate social sign-up options, and a July 2020 post in New Relic's DEV Community organization lists a name and an e-mail address as the only input. Only a live attempt at the form shows today's behaviour; the record keeps unverified: behind a sign-up.
